SnapFolio direction

Rebuilt from the template you sent, using its real values: #1f1f1f canvas, #232323 surfaces, #ececec accent, Roboto / Ubuntu / Nunito, 300px fixed sidebar nav, 60px section padding.

Same section order as the template: hero, about, stats, skills, resume, portfolio, services, testimonials, contact.

Anything in [square brackets] with a dotted underline is waiting on your real details — surname, companies, dates, city, email, phone, photos, screenshots and every number.

The skill bars are set to sample lengths. Set each one to a level you'd defend in an interview, or drop the percentages entirely.

SnapFolio's accent is near-white (#ececec), so the whole thing reads monochrome.

Each artboard has an accent control above it with three colour presets if you'd rather not stay grey.

Licence note: SnapFolio is a BootstrapMade template. Its free licence requires keeping the "Designed by BootstrapMade" credit in the footer — it's in the mockup. Buying the pro licence lets you remove it.

The first direction — light editorial, warm paper and ink with one clay accent.

Kept here so you can compare. Say the word and I'll delete it.
